headline: Preserve trustworthy evidence and repair verified release drift

items.title: Bind pixels at capture time and preserve prior image evidence
items.insight: Capture source, candidate and image hashes when the browser produces pixels, then preserve those facts during receipt publication. Give each run immutable image paths and refuse stale provenance or collisions before changing retained evidence. Verify the actual writer with positive and negative fixtures while preserving previous receipts and review status.

items.title: Remove stale active-project claims from Oracle catalog context
items.insight: Remove the duplicated active-project claims from the games Oracle context. Preserve page-specific guidance, the existing authoritative snapshot and every request, provider, budget and membership contract. Verify the actual context and outgoing payload offline without calling a model.

items.title: Review and correct three proven stale Linux reference cells
items.insight: Review the three selected Linux cells at original resolution after the exact-artifact trust decision. Accept a reference only when the intended scene is correct and its bytes match independent current capture evidence. Preserve old images and failures, disclose the unknown historical cause and require the unchanged native comparison to pass.

items.title: Complete isolated account acceptance and authorized release promotion
items.insight: Verify a real isolated staging target and both affected account journeys before promotion. Require exact candidate workflows, current staging, rollback and production readback under the existing deployment authorization. Keep trust, registration or acceptance dependencies pending when their actual prerequisites remain unresolved.
